result.summary: The page is largely well-designed with a clean layout and consistent styling. Only minor visual issues were found: truncated restaurant name text and edge-clipped carousel cards.

issues.description: The third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word, making it hard to read the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the card to fully scroll into view or ensure the name wraps/is fully rendered before ellipsis truncation.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel cards are cut off at the right edge of the screen with no visual affordance (e.g., partial peek of next card or scroll indicator) beyond the clipped image.
issues.suggestion: Keep a consistent partial-card peek or add subtle scroll indicators to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The promotional banner's decorative circles create slightly uneven contrast with the green background, though the 'Order now' button remains clearly visible.
issues.suggestion: Verify text contrast over all decorative background shapes remains WCAG AA compliant.
